title: Acknowledgments and grant support
text:
Acknowledgments and grant support
This symposium is an open-access academic dissemination event organized as part of an active research project. The coordination, development, and hosting of this event are supported by time allocations funded under the following research grant:

Project Title: Clinical Prediction Models for Surgical Outcomes
Funding Agency: Swiss National Science Foundation (SNSF)
Grant Number: 235046
Host Institution: UMC Utrecht / Universitätsspital Basel

We are deeply grateful to our funding bodies for enabling the dedicated research time required to bring this international network together.
This symposium is made possible through the financial support and resources provided by our partner institutions and funding agencies.
Our core funding allows this event to remain completely free of charge for all registered academic and clinical attendees.

Organizing & Supporting Institutions

UMC Utrecht
